agentPaths._comment: Paths to agent directories. These are relative to the gumroad_agent directory.

github._comment: GitHub config for source repo + Pages deploy. Set username and repo to enable auto-upload.

gumroad._comment: Get an access token at gumroad.com/settings/advanced under Applications. Prefer the GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN env var over storing it here.

airouter._comment: Airouter endpoint for listing copy generation.
